details: The US Producer Price Index (PPI) increased by 6.3% year-on-year in September, surpassing the forecasted 5.3%. This hotter-than-expected inflation data has intensified concerns about potential Federal Reserve interest rate hikes. The news triggered significant volatility in cryptocurrency markets, with Bitcoin briefly falling below $80,000 before rebounding above $82,000, amidst nearly $950 million in leveraged crypto liquidations.
title: US Producer Prices Rise, Fueling Inflation Fears and Crypto Sell-Off.

details: Russia's Central Bank has confirmed its plans to soon implement a ban on peer-to-peer Bitcoin trading. This regulatory move is seen as an effort to control cryptocurrency transactions and limit their use, potentially impacting the accessibility and liquidity of Bitcoin within Russia.
title: Russia to Ban Peer-to-Peer Bitcoin Trading, Central Bank Confirms.

details: G20 finance ministers and central bankers convened to address the economic fallout from the ongoing Iran war, which continues to pose a significant threat to global energy supplies and overall economic stability. In related news, the IMF's October 2026 assessment highlighted rising fiscal deficits, AI disruption, and cyber threats as major risks to global financial markets.
title: G20 Discusses Iran War Fallout; IMF Flags Global Financial Risks.
